sources.title: 台湾国家图书馆000002203《新命理探原》1915香港润德馆目与487页书目
sources.provider: Taiwan National Central Library / 臺灣華文電子書庫
sources.quality_notes: Institution records 袁樹珊撰, 香港, 潤德, 1915, 487 pages, registration 000002203. Commons transcribes this same NCL source and provides PDF 486 digital pages, which are not yet mapped one-to-one to institutional page count. Original title/copyright/glyph were not directly reviewed. This is not proof of first edition or of Hong Kong teaching lineage, and cannot be silently normalized to CText received-title 命理探源.

sources.title: 台湾国家图书馆9910006747《增訂命理探原》1938镇江润德堂再版馆目
sources.provider: Taiwan National Central Library / 臺灣華文電子書庫
sources.quality_notes: Firstparty edition item records 袁樹珊著, 鎮江, 潤德堂, 1938, 再版, 266 pages, registration 001583936 (digital collection ID NCL-9910006747). Commons same underlying NCL-sourced scanned PDF is 266 pages, not an independent physical copy. No original title/colophon direct read because PDF bytes/pages could not be opened; reprint label cannot by itself prove 1915 新命理探原 is the prior edition, same plates, or same instruction.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: 1915 新命理探原 and 1938 增訂命理探原 are linked only at same-author/family-title catalog level; no proved direct edition plate or work-body identity.
Root CText 命理探源 title and NCL 命理探原 are not yet bound at original page scope.
Commons mirror and NCL source are not independent physical witnesses.
unresolved_lineage_questions: 1915 and 1938 first edition/original title-page and printing colophon, 486/487 digital-vs-catalog page mapping
Yuan Shushan author self-acknowledgment and whether 1938 is a revision of a particular 1915 textual base
Contemporary evidence of practices, teaching, distribution, and later use across Hong Kong and Zhenjiang
